text: Actress Chris MacNeil rents a large house in Georgetown with her twelve-year-old daughter Regan, who finds [a spirit board|trigger|calling on unseen powers] and talks with someone she calls Captain Howdy. Soon Regan's bed shakes, she speaks in a voice that is not hers, and doctors can find no cause. When [the thing inside her claims to be the Devil|threat|the devil and dark gods] and [the words 'help me' rise on her stomach from within|images|wounded and changing bodies], Father Damien Karras, a priest losing his faith, seeks permission to [perform an exorcism|rules|faith and charms protect].
